_about: Scroll journey on the homepage. Each checkpoint is a real place (lat/lon). The line drawn between them is a smooth curve for storytelling, not a walking route and not a record of club hikes. Captions are sample copy: edit freely. 'hikeIds' links a checkpoint to entries in data/hikes.json so the page can point to a real upcoming hike or a blog story. 'via' adds optional [lat, lon] bend points on the way to that checkpoint.
label: Illustrative journey

checkpoints.name: CUHK
checkpoints.title: Home base
checkpoints.caption: Campus sits on a hillside above Tolo Harbour. From here the hills are closer than they look.

photo.alt: Tolo Harbour and its islands under broken cloud, seen from the CUHK campus

checkpoints.name: Ma On Shan
checkpoints.title: The ridge across the water
checkpoints.caption: The saddle-shaped skyline you can see from campus. Up top it turns into open grassland with long views over Sai Kung.

photo.alt: A dirt path along the grassy Ngong Ping plateau in Ma On Shan Country Park, with Port Shelter in the distance

checkpoints.name: Sai Kung East
checkpoints.title: Where the road runs out
checkpoints.caption: Past the last bus stop, the peninsula turns into beaches, headlands and very blue water. Worth every step back out.

photo.alt: A sharp green peak above a bright blue bay and sandy beach on the Sai Kung coast

checkpoints.name: Lion Rock
checkpoints.title: The city, from above
checkpoints.caption: A short, steep climb from the streets of Kowloon to a ridge with the whole city laid out below. Best in late-afternoon light.

photo.alt: Golden haze over Kowloon tower blocks, seen from Lion Rock Country Park

checkpoints.name: Tai Mo Shan
checkpoints.title: The top of Hong Kong
checkpoints.caption: The highest point in the city, and often inside a cloud. On a clear day the whole territory opens up around you.

photo.alt: Tai Mo Shan rising behind a reservoir, framed by long grass in the foreground

checkpoints.name: Sunset Peak
checkpoints.title: Silvergrass and stone huts
checkpoints.caption: Come in autumn, when the slopes turn gold, and look for the old stone cabins scattered just below the top.

photo.alt: Golden silvergrass on the slopes of Sunset Peak on Lantau, with small stone cabins near the top

checkpoints.name: Dragon’s Back
checkpoints.title: Finish at the beach
checkpoints.caption: A rolling ridge on the south-east corner of Hong Kong Island. The path drops down to Big Wave Bay, which is the whole point.
checkpoints.fact: Section 8 of the Hong Kong Trail

photo.alt: Hikers on the Dragon’s Back ridge path with silvergrass in the foreground and the sea beyond
